Before you start

Your thyroid number is not the whole story

Most people with Hashimoto's get one thing: a TSH result and a prescription. If that were the whole answer, you would feel fine by now.

This screener walks through the upstream drivers that research has connected to thyroid autoimmunity, and tells you which ones your own answers point toward. It takes about five minutes.

What it does not do: it does not diagnose anything, and it cannot tell you that any infection or deficiency is causing your thyroid condition. What it gives you is an ordered list of what is worth testing, and in what order, so you stop paying for panels out of sequence.

36 questions across 10 short steps. Nothing is sent anywhere until you choose to see your results.

Root Cause Unlocked is an education and screening resource from Adam Seay, D.C. It is not medical advice, does not diagnose or treat disease, and does not replace evaluation by your own clinician. Never start, stop, or change a prescription based on anything here.
